targeted_audit_scope: Stage 2 DoD audit for PRD-04 WebUI PM Workspace, with emphasis on hash URL rendering of distinct storyboard-aligned dummy app surfaces and browser evidence from tmp/test_puppeteer_dir/webui-pm-workspace-stage2/metadata.json.

contract_conformance.tool_evidence: 4/4 contract ds_ids present; browser evidence shows 8/8 hashes render distinct active surfaces; 2/8 browser hasMatchingVisibleScreen checks false for task/doc surfaces; exact YAML labels mostly present with Logo label drift.

visual_token_fidelity.tool_evidence: 18/18 var(--*) tokens used by target files resolve to ds-manifest; 0 hardcoded hex/rgb/rgba/hsl colors; registry classes used for buttons, badges, tables, skeletons, graph nodes, heatmap cells.

flow_state_integrity.tool_evidence: 15/15 Mermaid flow states covered by normalized implementation states; handlers exist for Toggle Sidebar, Drill-down, View Trace, Approve, Reject, Request Changes; task-list context slice requires saving state but task-list state options omit saving.

accessibility.tool_evidence: Skip link, main/header/nav/aside/footer/search landmarks, aria-current, aria-live/status regions, labeled controls, focus-visible rings, Ctrl+K and Escape path present; browser activeAria includes duplicate active labels and docs sidebar hydration mismatch can leave active indication inconsistent.

efficiency_completeness.tool_evidence: page.tsx 351 lines and workspace-components.tsx 121 lines, both under 400; 0 TODO/placeholder patterns; task-list dummy app lacks context-slice pagination, board/list toggle, and CSV export details.

safety_self_verification.tool_evidence: 0 dangerouslySetInnerHTML; no browser-side shell/database access; browser evidence records one hydration mismatch in docs sidebar active class outside target surface.

fix_queue.detail: Browser evidence reports React hydration mismatch for docs sidebar active class at /design-system/webui-pm-workspace#surface-rtm-dashboard: server class docs-sidebar__subitem differs from client docs-sidebar__subitem active. Stabilize server/client active route derivation for hash URLs.

Browser metadata marks hasMatchingVisibleScreen=false for #surface-tasks and #surface-docs even though distinct panels render; align data-screen-id/expected-screen aliases with context slices for screen:task-list and screen:doc-viewer.

Task list context slice requires sortable table with filters, pagination, board/list toggle, CSV export, and bulk action bar; implementation covers filters/table/bulk action but omits pagination, board/list toggle, and CSV export controls.
screen_task-list--default-loading--desktop.yaml includes saving in the task-list state matrix; task-list surface state options currently use recoveryStates and omit saving.
